changeSet.sql: UPDATE parallel_sprint_heats SET slot_1_resolved = (round_number = 1 OR crew_1_id IS NOT NULL), slot_2_resolved = (round_number = 1 OR crew_2_id IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE parallel_sprint_heats bronze SET slot_1_resolved = true WHERE bronze.heat_number = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM parallel_sprint_heats semi JOIN parallel_sprint_heats final_a ON final_a.id = semi.next_heat_id WHERE semi.bracket_id = bronze.bracket_id AND semi.next_slot = 1 AND semi.winner_slot IS NOT NULL AND final_a.round_number = bronze.round_number AND final_a.heat_number = 1 AND final_a.next_heat_id IS NULL)

UPDATE parallel_sprint_heats bronze SET slot_2_resolved = true WHERE bronze.heat_number = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM parallel_sprint_heats semi JOIN parallel_sprint_heats final_a ON final_a.id = semi.next_heat_id WHERE semi.bracket_id = bronze.bracket_id AND semi.next_slot = 2 AND semi.winner_slot IS NOT NULL AND final_a.round_number = bronze.round_number AND final_a.heat_number = 1 AND final_a.next_heat_id IS NULL)
